text: {"name":"ble_ll_tx_packet_setup","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Parses a supported packet-record kind, advances the shared input cursor, and populates packet words, a backing-buffer address, and control flags.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"packet_data","a2":"record_type_flags","v2":"packet_control_block","v3":"cursor_offset","v4":"record_kind","v5":"buffer_select_flag","v6":"record_data"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"Current input cursor offset; advanced after processing a record."},{"offset":9,"meaning":"Buffer-pool index used by one backing-buffer address calculation."},{"offset":10,"meaning":"Buffer-pool index used by the alternate backing-buffer address calculation."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"First packet word populated from the record."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Second packet word populated from the record."},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Backing-buffer address selected for the packet."},{"offset":48,"meaning":"Packet control flags, with bits ORed in for supported record kinds."}]}
